Theory HOLCF-extra.Bounded_Complete

theory Bounded_Complete imports HOLCF Top Definitions FiniteCF Directed begin

default_sort po

class bounded_complete = pcpo +
  assumes ex_bound_ne_ex_lub: "A ≠ {} ⟹ A <| b ⟹ ∃a. A <<| a"
begin

lemma ex_bound_ex_lub: "A <| b ⟹ ∃a. A <<| a"
  by (cases "A = {}") (auto intro: ex_bound_ne_ex_lub lub_empty)

lemma ex_bound_lub: "A <| b ⟹ A <<| lub A"
  using ex_bound_ex_lub[THEN exE] is_lub_lub by blast

lemma join_is_lub: "x ⊑ z ⟹ y ⊑ z ⟹ {x, y} <<| x ⊔ y"
  using ex_bound_lub[of "{x, y}" z] by (simp add: join_def)

lemma join_belowI: "x ⊑ z ⟹ y ⊑ z ⟹ x ⊔ y ⊑ z"
  using join_is_lub[THEN lub_below_iff']
  by simp

lemma lub_belowI: "A ≠ {} ⟹ A <| b ⟹ lub A ⊑ b"
  using ex_bound_lub[THEN is_lubD2]
  by simp

lemma below_lubI: "A <| b ⟹ x ∈ A ⟹ x ⊑ lub A"
  using ex_bound_lub[THEN is_lubD1, THEN is_ubD] .

lemma is_glb: fixes S :: "'a set" assumes "S ≠ {}"
  obtains s where "is_glb S s"
proof -
  from assms obtain y where "y ∈ S" by blast
  define B where "B ≡ {x. ∀y ∈ S. x ⊑ y}"
  have "⊥ ∈ B" unfolding B_def by simp
  then have 1: "B ≠ {}" by auto
  from ‹y ∈ S› have 2: "B <| y" by (simp add: B_def is_ub_def)
  from 1 2 obtain s where s: "B <<| s" using ex_bound_ex_lub by auto
  have sinB: "s ⊑ y" if "y ∈ S" for y
  proof -
    from that have "B <| y" by (simp add: B_def is_ub_def)
    with s show ?thesis by (rule is_lubD2)
  qed
  have "x ⊑ s ⟷ (∀y ∈ S. x ⊑ y)" for x
  proof
    show "x ⊑ s ⟹ (∀y ∈ S. x ⊑ y)"
      using below_trans[of x s, OF _ sinB] by blast
    show "(∀y ∈ S. x ⊑ y) ⟹ x ⊑ s"
      using s[THEN is_lubD1, THEN is_ubD, unfolded B_def]
      by simp
  qed
  with ‹S ≠ {}› have "is_glb S s" unfolding is_glb_def by simp
  then show ?thesis by (rule that)
qed

lemma glb: fixes S :: "'a set"
  assumes "S ≠ {}"
  shows "is_glb S (glb S)"
  using is_glb[OF assms] by (blast intro: is_glb_glb)

lemma glb_below: "x ∈ S ⟹ glb S ⊑ x"
  by (auto intro: glb is_glb_below)

lemma glb_greatest: "S ≠ {} ⟹ (∀x ∈ S. b ⊑ x) ⟹ b ⊑ glb S"
  by (auto intro: glb is_glb_greatest)

lemma glb_below_iff: "S ≠ {} ⟹ (b ⊑ glb S) = (∀x ∈ S. b ⊑ x)"
  by (drule glb) (simp add: is_glb_def)

lemma glb_eq_lub:
  assumes "S ≠ {}"
  shows "glb S = lub {x. ∀y ∈ S. x ⊑ y}" (is "_ = lub ?B")
proof (rule glb_eqI, rule is_glbI)
  obtain y where "y ∈ S" using assms by blast
  then have "?B <| y" by (simp add: is_ub_def)
  then have B: "?B <<| lub ?B" by (rule ex_bound_lub)
  show "lub ?B ⊑ x" if "x ∈ S" for x
    by (rule is_lubD2[OF B]) (simp add: is_ub_def that)
  show "b ⊑ lub ?B" if "∀x ∈ S. b ⊑ x" for b
    by (rule is_ubD[OF is_lubD1[OF B]]) (simp add: that)
qed

lemma meet_below1: "a ⊓ b ⊑ a" and meet_below2: "a ⊓ b ⊑ b"
  unfolding meet_def
  by (fast intro: glb_below)+

lemma meet_below_iff: "c ⊑ a ⊓ b ⟷ c ⊑ a ∧ c ⊑ b"
  unfolding meet_def
  by (auto simp add: glb_below_iff)

lemma meet_greatest: "c ⊑ a ⟹ c ⊑ b ⟹ c ⊑ a ⊓ b"
  by (auto simp add: meet_below_iff)

lemma meet_sym: "a ⊓ b = b ⊓ a"
  unfolding meet_def
  by (simp only: insert_commute)

definition joinable (infix "⇑" 50)
  where "a ⇑ b ≡ ∃z. a ⊑ z ∧ b ⊑ z"

lemma joinable_lub: "a ⇑ b ⟹ {a, b} <<| a ⊔ b"
  unfolding joinable_def
  by (fast intro: join_is_lub)

lemma joinableI: "a ⊑ c ⟹ b ⊑ c ⟹ a ⇑ b"
  unfolding joinable_def
  by fast

lemma joinableD: "a ⇑ b ⟹ a ⊑ a ⊔ b" "a ⇑ b ⟹ b ⊑ a ⊔ b"
  using joinable_lub
  by (auto dest: is_lubD1 is_ubD)

lemma joinable_mono1: "a ⇑ b ⟹ c ⊑ a ⟹ c ⇑ b"
  apply (frule joinableD(1), drule joinableD(2))
  apply (rule joinableI[of c "a ⊔ b" b])
   apply (rule below_trans[of c a])
  .

lemma joinable_refl[simp]: "a ⇑ a"
  unfolding joinable_def join_def by fast

lemma joinable_sym: "a ⇑ b ⟷ b ⇑ a"
  unfolding joinable_def
  by fast

lemma joinable_mono2: "a ⇑ b ⟹ c ⊑ b ⟹ a ⇑ c"
  using joinable_mono1 joinable_sym by metis

text ‹A fact rather than a ‹sublocale›, for the same reason as @{thm [source] below_order}.›

lemma semilattice_meet: "class.semilattice_inf meet below below_strict"
  by (rule class.semilattice_inf.intro[OF below_order])
    (unfold_locales, (fact meet_below1 meet_below2 meet_greatest)+)

lemma join_mono1: "c ⊔ b ⊑ a ⊔ b" if "a ⇑ b" "c ⊑ a"
proof -
  from that have "c ⊑ a ⊔ b" by (blast intro: below_trans joinableD(1))
  also from that have "b ⊑ a ⊔ b" by (blast intro: joinableD(2))
  finally(join_belowI) show ?thesis.
qed

lemma join_mono2: "a ⊔ c ⊑ a ⊔ b" if "a ⇑ b" "c ⊑ b"
  by (metis join_mono1 join_sym joinable_sym that)

lemma join_absorbI: "a ⊑ b ⟹ a ⊔ b = b"
  by (meson below_antisym below_refl join_belowI joinableD(2) joinableI)

lemma joinable_if_below1[simp]: "a ⊑ b ⟹ a ⇑ b"
  by (auto intro: joinableI)

lemma joinable_if_below2[simp]: "a ⊑ b ⟹ b ⇑ a"
  by (auto intro: joinableI)

corollary join_absorb_meet[simp]: "(a ⊓ b) ⊔ b = b"
  by (auto intro: join_absorbI meet_below2)

corollary join_absorb_meet2[simp]: "a ⊔ (a ⊓ b) = a"
  using join_absorb_meet join_sym meet_sym by metis

corollary join_absorb_meet3[simp]: "(b ⊓ a) ⊔ b = b"
  by (simp add: meet_sym)

corollary join_absorb_meet4[simp]: "a ⊔ (b ⊓ a) = a"
  by (simp add: meet_sym)

lemma meet_absorbI: "a ⊑ b ⟹ a ⊓ b = a"
  by (rule semilattice_inf.inf_absorb1[OF semilattice_meet])

corollary meet_absorb_join[simp]: "a ⇑ b ⟹ (a ⊔ b) ⊓ a = a"
  using meet_absorbI[OF joinableD(1)] by (simp add: meet_sym)

lemma join_assoc: assumes "a ⇑ b" "b ⇑ c" "a ⊔ b ⇑ c" "a ⇑ b ⊔ c"
  shows "(a ⊔ b) ⊔ c = a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)"
  by (intro below_antisym join_belowI joinableD assms)
   (metis join_belowI joinableD assms below_trans)+

lemma joinable_simps[simp]:
  assumes "a ⇑ b"
  shows
  "a ⇑ a ⊔ b" "a ⊔ b ⇑ a"
  "b ⇑ a ⊔ b" "a ⊔ b ⇑ b"
  "a ⇑ b ⊓ d" "a ⊓ c ⇑ b"
  "a ⊓ c ⇑ b ⊓ d"
proof -
  from assms show "a ⊓ c ⇑ b" by (auto intro: joinable_mono1 meet_below1)
  then show "a ⊓ c ⇑ b ⊓ d" by (auto intro: joinable_mono2 meet_below1)
  from assms show "a ⇑ b ⊓ d" by (auto intro: joinable_mono2 meet_below1)
qed (auto intro: joinable_mono1 joinable_mono2 joinableD[OF assms] joinableI)

end

lemmas bounded_complete_locale_eqs [class_locale_eqs] =
  bounded_complete_class.joinable_dict[symmetric]

lemma bounded_complete_finite_joinI:
  assumes "⋀a b c::'a::dcpo. ⟦ a ⊑ c; b ⊑ c ⟧ ⟹ ∃z. {a, b} <<| z"
  shows "OFCLASS('a, bounded_complete_class)"
proof
  from assms have joinI: "a ⊑ c ⟹ b ⊑ c ⟹ {a, b} <<| a ⊔ b" for a b c :: 'a
    unfolding join_def using is_lub_lub by blast
  have "B <| z ⟹ ∃b. B <<| b" if "finite B"
    for z and B :: "'a set"
    using that(1)
  proof (induction B rule: finite_induct)
    case empty
    then show ?case by (blast intro: lub_empty)
  next
    case (insert x F)
    from insert.prems have prev: "F <| z" and x: "x ⊑ z" by simp_all
    from insert.IH[OF prev] obtain w where w: "F <<| w" ..
    from w prev have "w ⊑ z" by (rule is_lubD2)
    with x have pairlub: "{x, w} <<| x ⊔ w" by (rule joinI)
    from is_lubD1[OF this] have belows: "x ⊑ x ⊔ w" "w ⊑ x ⊔ w" 
      by simp_all
    have "(insert x F) <<| x ⊔ w"
    proof (rule is_lubI)
      show "insert x F <| x ⊔ w" unfolding is_ub_insert
        using is_lubD1 pairlub w is_ub_upward belows by blast
    next
      fix u assume "insert x F <| u"
      then have "F <| u" and "x ⊑ u" by simp_all
      with is_lubD2[OF w] have "{x, w} <| u" by fastforce
      with is_lubD2[OF pairlub] show "x ⊔ w ⊑ u" .
    qed
    then show ?case ..
  qed
  then have finite_lub: "finite B ⟹ B <| z ⟹ B <<| lub B" for z and B :: "'a set"
    using is_lub_lub by auto
  fix A and b :: 'a assume "A ≠ {}" "A <| b"
  from ‹A <| b› have "B ∈ Fpow(A) ⟹ B <| b" for B
    unfolding Fpow_def is_ub_def by fast
  moreover have "B ∈ Fpow(A) ⟹ finite B" for B by (simp add: Fpow_def)
  ultimately have "B ∈ Fpow(A) ⟹ B <<| lub B" for B
    using finite_lub by fast
  with directed_join_of_finite_subsets(2)
  have "A <<| lub (lub ` Fpow(A))" by blast
  then show "∃a. A <<| a" ..
qed

lemma (in cpo) bin_join_chain1:
  assumes cX: "chain X"
   and Z: "⋀i. {X i, y} <<| Z i"
  shows "chain Z" and "{⨆i. X i, y} <<| (⨆i. Z i)"
proof -
  from Z show cZ: "chain Z"
    by (rule ch2ch_lub_gen) (blast intro: chainE[OF cX])
  show "{⨆i. X i, y} <<| (⨆i. Z i)"
  proof (rule is_lubI)
    from Z have "X i ⊑ Z i" for i using is_lubD1[THEN is_ubD] by blast
    with cX cZ have 1: "(⨆i. X i) ⊑ (⨆i. Z i)" by (rule lub_mono)
    from Z have "y ⊑ Z i" for i using is_lubD1[THEN is_ubD] by blast
    with cZ have 2: "y ⊑ (⨆i. Z i)" by (rule below_lub)
    from 1 2 show "{⨆i. X i, y} <| (⨆i. Z i)" by (intro is_ubI) auto
  next
    fix u assume u: "{⨆i. X i, y} <| u"
    from is_ubD[OF u] have 1: "(⨆i. X i) ⊑ u" and 2: "y ⊑ u" by auto
    from cX 1 have 1: "X i ⊑ u" for i using lub_below_iff by blast
    from 1 2 have "{X i, y} <| u" for i by (intro is_ubI) auto
    with Z have "Z i ⊑ u" for i by (rule is_lubD2)
    with cZ show "(⨆i. Z i) ⊑ u" by (rule lub_below)
  qed
qed

lemma (in cpo) ex_join_adm: "adm (λx. ∃z. {x, y} <<| z)"
proof (rule admI)
  fix X :: "nat ⇒ 'a"
  assume cX: "chain X"
  assume "∀i. ∃z. {X i, y} <<| z"
  then obtain Z where Z: "{X i, y} <<| Z i" for i by metis
  with cX bin_join_chain1(2) show "∃z. {⨆i. X i, y} <<| z" by blast
qed

lemma (in cpo) ex_join_adm2: "adm (λy. ∃z. {x, y} <<| z)"
  unfolding bin_join_ex_symm by (fact ex_join_adm)

lemma compact_eq_approx2:
  fixes a b :: "'a::bifinite"
  assumes "compact a" "compact b"
  obtains d where "finite_deflation d" "d⋅a = a" "d⋅b = b"
proof -
  from bifinite obtain approx :: "nat ⇒ 'a → 'a" where "approx_chain approx" ..
  then interpret approx_chain approx .
  note approx_mono = chain_mono[OF chain_approx,
      THEN deflation.belowD[OF deflation_approx]]
  from assms compact_eq_approx obtain i j where "approx i⋅a = a" "approx j⋅b = b" 
    by presburger
  with approx_mono have "approx (max i j)⋅a = a" "approx (max i j)⋅b = b"
    by (cases rule: le_cases[of i j], simp_all)+
  with finite_deflation_approx show ?thesis by (rule that)
qed

lemma compact_lubI:
  fixes a b :: "'a::bifinite"
  assumes compacts: "compact a" "compact b"
  assumes compactRule: "⋀c. compact c ⟹ a ⊑ c ⟹ b ⊑ c ⟹ a ⊑ F a b ∧ b ⊑ F a b ∧ F a b ⊑ c"
 and c: "a ⊑ c" "b ⊑ c"
shows "{a, b} <<| F a b"
proof (rule is_lubI)
  from compacts obtain d where "finite_deflation d" and fixing: "d⋅a = a" "d⋅b = b"
    by (rule compact_eq_approx2)
  then interpret finite_deflation d by presburger
  from c have "a ⊑ d⋅c" "b ⊑ d⋅c"
    by (subst fixing[symmetric], fast intro: monofun_cfun_arg)+
  moreover have "compact (d⋅c)" by (rule compact)
  ultimately have "a ⊑ F a b" "b ⊑ F a b" using compactRule by auto
  then show "{a, b} <| F a b" by simp
next
  fix u
  show "{a, b} <| u ⟹ F a b ⊑ u"
  proof (induction u rule: compact_induct', simp add: compacts)
    fix uu assume "compact uu" "{a, b} <| uu"
    with compactRule show "F a b ⊑ uu" by auto
  qed
qed


text ‹Bounded completeness through any chain of maps with lub ‹ID› (e.g. the ‹take› functions of
  a domain, or an approximation chain): it suffices that pairs of approximants have lubs
  under any common bound.›

lemma chain_bounded_lub:
  fixes t :: "nat ⇒ 'a::cpo → 'a"
  assumes t: "chain t" "(⨆i. t i) = ID"
    and lubs: "⋀n a b c. t n⋅a ⊑ c ⟹ t n⋅b ⊑ c ⟹ ∃z. {t n⋅a, t n⋅b} <<| z"
    and "(a::'a) ⊑ c" "b ⊑ c"
  shows "∃z. {a, b} <<| z"
proof -
  have reach: "(⨆n. t n⋅x) = x" for x
    by (simp add: contlub_cfun_fun[OF t(1), symmetric] t(2))
  have chx: "chain (λn. t n⋅x)" for x by (rule ch2ch_Rep_cfunL[OF t(1)])
  have below: "t n⋅x ⊑ x" for n x
    using is_ub_thelub[OF chx, of n x] by (simp add: reach)
  define L where "L n = lub {t n⋅a, t n⋅b}" for n
  have L: "{t n⋅a, t n⋅b} <<| L n" for n
  proof -
    have "t n⋅a ⊑ c" "t n⋅b ⊑ c"
      using below ‹a ⊑ c› ‹b ⊑ c› by (blast intro: below_trans)+
    from lubs[OF this] obtain z where "{t n⋅a, t n⋅b} <<| z" by (elim exE)
    then show ?thesis unfolding L_def by (rule is_lub_lub)
  qed
  have chL: "chain L"
  proof (rule chainI)
    fix n
    have "t n⋅a ⊑ L (Suc n)" "t n⋅b ⊑ L (Suc n)"
      using chainE[OF chx] is_lubD1[OF L, THEN is_ubD]
      by (blast intro: below_trans)+
    then show "L n ⊑ L (Suc n)" by (blast intro: is_lubD2[OF L] is_ubI)
  qed
  have "{a, b} <<| (⨆n. L n)"
  proof (rule is_lubI)
    have "(⨆n. t n⋅a) ⊑ (⨆n. L n)" "(⨆n. t n⋅b) ⊑ (⨆n. L n)"
      using is_lubD1[OF L, THEN is_ubD] by (blast intro: lub_mono chx chL)+
    then show "{a, b} <| (⨆n. L n)" by (simp add: reach is_ub_def)
  next
    fix u assume "{a, b} <| u"
    then have "a ⊑ u" "b ⊑ u" by (auto dest: is_ubD)
    then have "L n ⊑ u" for n
      using below by (blast intro: is_lubD2[OF L] is_ubI below_trans)
    then show "(⨆n. L n) ⊑ u" by (rule lub_below[OF chL])
  qed
  then show ?thesis ..
qed

lemma bounded_complete_chainI:
  fixes t :: "nat ⇒ 'a::dcpo → 'a"
  assumes "chain t" "(⨆i. t i) = ID"
    and "⋀n a b c. t n⋅a ⊑ c ⟹ t n⋅b ⊑ c ⟹ ∃z. {t n⋅a, t n⋅b} <<| z"
  shows "OFCLASS('a, bounded_complete_class)"
  by (rule bounded_complete_finite_joinI) (rule chain_bounded_lub[OF assms])

text ‹The compact version is the approximation-chain instance.›

lemma bounded_complete_finite_compact_joinI:
  assumes "⋀a b c::'a::bifinite. ⟦ compact a; compact b; a ⊑ c; b ⊑ c ⟧ ⟹ ∃z. {a, b} <<| z"
  shows "OFCLASS('a, bounded_complete_class)"
proof (rule bounded_complete_finite_joinI)
  fix a b c :: 'a assume "a ⊑ c" "b ⊑ c"
  from bifinite obtain approx :: "nat ⇒ 'a → 'a" where "approx_chain approx" ..
  then interpret approx_chain approx .
  show "∃z. {a, b} <<| z"
    by (rule chain_bounded_lub[OF chain_approx lub_approx _ ‹a ⊑ c› ‹b ⊑ c›], rule assms) simp_all
qed

lemma bounded_complete_finite_compact_joinI':
  assumes
    "⋀a b c::'a::bifinite. ⟦ compact a; compact b; compact c; a ⊑ c; b ⊑ c⟧ ⟹ a ⊑ F a b"
    "⋀a b c::'a::bifinite. ⟦ compact a; compact b; compact c; a ⊑ c; b ⊑ c⟧ ⟹ b ⊑ F a b"
    "⋀a b c::'a::bifinite. ⟦ compact a; compact b; compact c; a ⊑ c; b ⊑ c⟧ ⟹ F a b ⊑ c"
  shows "OFCLASS('a, bounded_complete_class)"
proof (rule bounded_complete_finite_compact_joinI)
  fix a b c :: 'a
  assume "compact a" "compact b" "a ⊑ c" "b ⊑ c"
  with assms have "{a, b} <<| F a b"
    by (intro compact_lubI[of a b F c]) presburger+
  then show "∃z. {a, b} <<| z" ..
qed

lemma down_below: "fup⋅ID⋅x ⊑ y ⟷ x ⊑ up⋅y"
  by (cases x) simp_all

corollary down_below_ub: "(λx. fup⋅ID⋅x) ` X <| y ⟷ X <| up⋅y"
  unfolding is_ub_def
  using down_below by blast

instance u :: (bounded_complete) bounded_complete
proof
  fix A :: "'a u set" assume "A ≠ {}"
  fix b assume "A <| b"
  show "∃a. A <<| a"
  proof (cases "A <| ⊥")
    case True
    from is_ubD[OF this] have "A = {} ∨ A = {⊥}" by auto
    then have "A <<| ⊥" by auto
    then show ?thesis ..
  next
    case False
    let ?down = "(λx. fup⋅ID⋅x)"
    from ‹A <| b› have 1: "?down ` A <| ?down b"
      by (simp add: is_ub_def monofun_cfun_arg)
    define a where "a = lub (?down ` A)"
    thm ex_bound_lub
    from 1 have a: "?down ` A <<| a" unfolding a_def by (rule ex_bound_lub)
    have "A <<| up⋅a"
    proof (rule is_lubI)
      show "A <| up⋅a" using a[THEN is_lubD1] down_below_ub by blast
      fix u assume "A <| u"
      with ‹¬(A <| ⊥)› obtain u' where *: "u = up⋅u'" "A <| up⋅u'" by (cases u) simp_all
      then have "?down ` A <| u'" by (simp add: down_below_ub)
      with a have "a ⊑ u'" by (rule is_lubD2)
      with * show "up⋅a ⊑ u" by simp
    qed
    then show ?thesis ..
  qed
qed

lemma meet_bottom [simp]:
  fixes x :: "'a::bounded_complete"
  shows "x ⊓ ⊥ = ⊥" "⊥ ⊓ x = ⊥"
  by (simp_all add: meet_sym meet_absorbI)

lemma up_joinable_iff [simp]:
  fixes x y :: "'a::bounded_complete"
  shows "up⋅x ⇑ up⋅y ⟷ x ⇑ y"
proof
  assume "up⋅x ⇑ up⋅y"
  then obtain z where "up⋅x ⊑ z" "up⋅y ⊑ z" unfolding joinable_def by blast
  then show "x ⇑ y" by (cases z) (auto intro: joinableI)
next
  assume "x ⇑ y"
  then obtain z where "x ⊑ z" "y ⊑ z" unfolding joinable_def by blast
  then show "up⋅x ⇑ up⋅y" by (auto intro: joinableI[of _ "up⋅z"])
qed

lemma up_join:
  fixes x y :: "'a::bounded_complete"
  assumes "x ⇑ y" shows "up⋅x ⊔ up⋅y = up⋅(x ⊔ y)"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  have xy: "up⋅x ⇑ up⋅y" using assms by simp
  show "up⋅x ⊔ up⋅y ⊑ up⋅(x ⊔ y)"
    by (rule join_belowI) (simp_all add: joinableD[OF assms])
  have "up⋅x ⊑ up⋅x ⊔ up⋅y" "up⋅y ⊑ up⋅x ⊔ up⋅y" using joinableD[OF xy] by simp_all
  then show "up⋅(x ⊔ y) ⊑ up⋅x ⊔ up⋅y"
    by (cases "up⋅x ⊔ up⋅y") (simp_all add: join_belowI)
qed

lemma up_meet [simp]:
  fixes x y :: "'a::bounded_complete"
  shows "up⋅x ⊓ up⋅y = up⋅(x ⊓ y)"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  show "up⋅(x ⊓ y) ⊑ up⋅x ⊓ up⋅y"
    by (rule meet_greatest) (simp_all add: meet_below1 meet_below2)
  have "up⋅x ⊓ up⋅y ⊑ up⋅x" "up⋅x ⊓ up⋅y ⊑ up⋅y" by (rule meet_below1, rule meet_below2)
  then show "up⋅x ⊓ up⋅y ⊑ up⋅(x ⊓ y)"
    by (cases "up⋅x ⊓ up⋅y") (simp_all add: meet_greatest)
qed


subsection ‹Strict sums›

text ‹A bounded set of a strict sum lies on one side, so its lub is computed there: projecting
  onto the side with ‹sscase› transports bounds back and forth.›

lemma ssum_lub_sinl:
  fixes A :: "('a::bounded_complete ⊕ 'b::bounded_complete) set"
  assumes "A <| sinl⋅b" shows "∃a. A <<| a"
proof -
  define d where "d = (sscase⋅ID⋅⊥ :: 'a ⊕ 'b → 'a)"
  define l where "l = lub ((λx. d⋅x) ` A)"
  have sinl_d_below: "sinl⋅(d⋅u) ⊑ u" for u by (cases u) (simp_all add: d_def)
  have sinl_d: "x = sinl⋅(d⋅x)" if "x ⊑ sinl⋅b" for x
    using that by (cases x) (simp_all add: d_def)
  have "d⋅x ⊑ b" if "x ∈ A" for x
    using monofun_cfun_arg[OF is_ubD[OF assms that], of d] by (cases "b = ⊥") (simp_all add: d_def)
  then have "(λx. d⋅x) ` A <| b" by (auto intro: is_ubI)
  then have l: "(λx. d⋅x) ` A <<| l" unfolding l_def by (rule ex_bound_lub)
  have "A <<| sinl⋅l"
  proof (rule is_lubI)
    show "A <| sinl⋅l"
    proof (rule is_ubI)
      fix x assume x: "x ∈ A"
      have "d⋅x ⊑ l" using x by (blast intro: is_ubD[OF is_lubD1[OF l]])
      then have "sinl⋅(d⋅x) ⊑ sinl⋅l" by (rule monofun_cfun_arg)
      then show "x ⊑ sinl⋅l"
        by (rule back_subst) (rule sinl_d[OF is_ubD[OF assms x], symmetric])
    qed
  next
    fix u assume "A <| u"
    then have "(λx. d⋅x) ` A <| d⋅u" by (auto intro!: is_ubI monofun_cfun_arg dest: is_ubD)
    with l have "l ⊑ d⋅u" by (rule is_lubD2)
    then have "sinl⋅l ⊑ sinl⋅(d⋅u)" by (rule monofun_cfun_arg)
    then show "sinl⋅l ⊑ u" using sinl_d_below by (rule below_trans)
  qed
  then show ?thesis ..
qed

lemma ssum_lub_sinr:
  fixes A :: "('a::bounded_complete ⊕ 'b::bounded_complete) set"
  assumes "A <| sinr⋅b" shows "∃a. A <<| a"
proof -
  define d where "d = (sscase⋅⊥⋅ID :: 'a ⊕ 'b → 'b)"
  define l where "l = lub ((λx. d⋅x) ` A)"
  have sinr_d_below: "sinr⋅(d⋅u) ⊑ u" for u by (cases u) (simp_all add: d_def)
  have sinr_d: "x = sinr⋅(d⋅x)" if "x ⊑ sinr⋅b" for x
    using that by (cases x) (simp_all add: d_def)
  have "d⋅x ⊑ b" if "x ∈ A" for x
    using monofun_cfun_arg[OF is_ubD[OF assms that], of d] by (cases "b = ⊥") (simp_all add: d_def)
  then have "(λx. d⋅x) ` A <| b" by (auto intro: is_ubI)
  then have l: "(λx. d⋅x) ` A <<| l" unfolding l_def by (rule ex_bound_lub)
  have "A <<| sinr⋅l"
  proof (rule is_lubI)
    show "A <| sinr⋅l"
    proof (rule is_ubI)
      fix x assume x: "x ∈ A"
      have "d⋅x ⊑ l" using x by (blast intro: is_ubD[OF is_lubD1[OF l]])
      then have "sinr⋅(d⋅x) ⊑ sinr⋅l" by (rule monofun_cfun_arg)
      then show "x ⊑ sinr⋅l"
        by (rule back_subst) (rule sinr_d[OF is_ubD[OF assms x], symmetric])
    qed
  next
    fix u assume "A <| u"
    then have "(λx. d⋅x) ` A <| d⋅u" by (auto intro!: is_ubI monofun_cfun_arg dest: is_ubD)
    with l have "l ⊑ d⋅u" by (rule is_lubD2)
    then have "sinr⋅l ⊑ sinr⋅(d⋅u)" by (rule monofun_cfun_arg)
    then show "sinr⋅l ⊑ u" using sinr_d_below by (rule below_trans)
  qed
  then show ?thesis ..
qed

instance ssum :: (bounded_complete, bounded_complete) bounded_complete
proof
  fix A :: "('a ⊕ 'b) set" and b assume b: "A <| b"
  show "∃a. A <<| a"
  proof (cases b)
    case bottom with b show ?thesis using ssum_lub_sinl[of A ⊥] by simp
  next
    case (sinl x) with b show ?thesis by (simp add: ssum_lub_sinl)
  next
    case (sinr y) with b show ?thesis by (simp add: ssum_lub_sinr)
  qed
qed

context
  fixes x x' :: "'a::bounded_complete" and y y' :: "'b::bounded_complete"
begin

lemma sinl_meet [simp]: "sinl⋅x ⊓ sinl⋅x' = (sinl⋅(x ⊓ x') :: 'a ⊕ 'b)"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  let ?m = "sinl⋅x ⊓ sinl⋅x' :: 'a ⊕ 'b"
  show "sinl⋅(x ⊓ x') ⊑ ?m"
    by (rule meet_greatest) (simp_all add: meet_below1 meet_below2)
  have "?m ⊑ sinl⋅x" "?m ⊑ sinl⋅x'" by (rule meet_below1, rule meet_below2)
  then show "?m ⊑ sinl⋅(x ⊓ x')"
    by (cases ?m) (simp_all add: meet_greatest)
qed

lemma sinr_meet [simp]: "sinr⋅y ⊓ sinr⋅y' = (sinr⋅(y ⊓ y') :: 'a ⊕ 'b)"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  let ?m = "sinr⋅y ⊓ sinr⋅y' :: 'a ⊕ 'b"
  show "sinr⋅(y ⊓ y') ⊑ ?m"
    by (rule meet_greatest) (simp_all add: meet_below1 meet_below2)
  have "?m ⊑ sinr⋅y" "?m ⊑ sinr⋅y'" by (rule meet_below1, rule meet_below2)
  then show "?m ⊑ sinr⋅(y ⊓ y')"
    by (cases ?m) (simp_all add: meet_greatest)
qed

lemma sinl_sinr_meet [simp]: "sinl⋅x ⊓ sinr⋅y = (⊥ :: 'a ⊕ 'b)" "sinr⋅y ⊓ sinl⋅x = (⊥ :: 'a ⊕ 'b)"
proof -
  have "sinl⋅x ⊓ sinr⋅y ⊑ sinl⋅x" "sinl⋅x ⊓ sinr⋅y ⊑ (sinr⋅y :: 'a ⊕ 'b)"
    by (rule meet_below1, rule meet_below2)
  then show "sinl⋅x ⊓ sinr⋅y = (⊥ :: 'a ⊕ 'b)"
    by (cases "sinl⋅x ⊓ sinr⋅y :: 'a ⊕ 'b") simp_all
  then show "sinr⋅y ⊓ sinl⋅x = (⊥ :: 'a ⊕ 'b)" by (simp add: meet_sym)
qed

lemma sinl_joinable_iff [simp]: "(sinl⋅x :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinl⋅x' ⟷ x ⇑ x'"
proof
  assume "(sinl⋅x :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinl⋅x'"
  then obtain z :: "'a ⊕ 'b" where "sinl⋅x ⊑ z" "sinl⋅x' ⊑ z" unfolding joinable_def by blast
  then show "x ⇑ x'" by (cases z) (auto intro: joinableI)
next
  assume "x ⇑ x'"
  then obtain z where "x ⊑ z" "x' ⊑ z" unfolding joinable_def by blast
  then show "(sinl⋅x :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinl⋅x'" by (auto intro: joinableI[of _ "sinl⋅z"])
qed

lemma sinr_joinable_iff [simp]: "(sinr⋅y :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinr⋅y' ⟷ y ⇑ y'"
proof
  assume "(sinr⋅y :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinr⋅y'"
  then obtain z :: "'a ⊕ 'b" where "sinr⋅y ⊑ z" "sinr⋅y' ⊑ z" unfolding joinable_def by blast
  then show "y ⇑ y'" by (cases z) (auto intro: joinableI)
next
  assume "y ⇑ y'"
  then obtain z where "y ⊑ z" "y' ⊑ z" unfolding joinable_def by blast
  then show "(sinr⋅y :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinr⋅y'" by (auto intro: joinableI[of _ "sinr⋅z"])
qed

lemma sinl_sinr_joinable_iff [simp]:
  "(sinl⋅x :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinr⋅y ⟷ x = ⊥ ∨ y = ⊥" "(sinr⋅y :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinl⋅x ⟷ x = ⊥ ∨ y = ⊥"
proof -
  have "(sinl⋅x :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinr⋅y ⟷ x = ⊥ ∨ y = ⊥"
  proof
    assume "(sinl⋅x :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinr⋅y"
    then obtain z :: "'a ⊕ 'b" where "sinl⋅x ⊑ z" "sinr⋅y ⊑ z" unfolding joinable_def by blast
    then show "x = ⊥ ∨ y = ⊥" by (cases z) simp_all
  qed auto
  then show "(sinl⋅x :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinr⋅y ⟷ x = ⊥ ∨ y = ⊥"
    "(sinr⋅y :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinl⋅x ⟷ x = ⊥ ∨ y = ⊥" by (simp_all add: joinable_sym)
qed

lemma sinl_join: "x ⇑ x' ⟹ sinl⋅x ⊔ sinl⋅x' = (sinl⋅(x ⊔ x') :: 'a ⊕ 'b)"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  assume xx: "x ⇑ x'"
  let ?j = "sinl⋅x ⊔ sinl⋅x' :: 'a ⊕ 'b"
  have j: "(sinl⋅x :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinl⋅x'" using xx by simp
  show "?j ⊑ sinl⋅(x ⊔ x')"
    by (rule join_belowI) (simp_all add: joinableD[OF xx])
  have "sinl⋅x ⊑ ?j" "sinl⋅x' ⊑ ?j" using joinableD[OF j] by simp_all
  then show "sinl⋅(x ⊔ x') ⊑ ?j"
    by (cases ?j) (simp_all add: join_belowI)
qed

lemma sinr_join: "y ⇑ y' ⟹ sinr⋅y ⊔ sinr⋅y' = (sinr⋅(y ⊔ y') :: 'a ⊕ 'b)"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  assume yy: "y ⇑ y'"
  let ?j = "sinr⋅y ⊔ sinr⋅y' :: 'a ⊕ 'b"
  have j: "(sinr⋅y :: 'a ⊕ 'b) ⇑ sinr⋅y'" using yy by simp
  show "?j ⊑ sinr⋅(y ⊔ y')"
    by (rule join_belowI) (simp_all add: joinableD[OF yy])
  have "sinr⋅y ⊑ ?j" "sinr⋅y' ⊑ ?j" using joinableD[OF j] by simp_all
  then show "sinr⋅(y ⊔ y') ⊑ ?j"
    by (cases ?j) (simp_all add: join_belowI)
qed

end


subsection ‹Cartesian products›

text ‹Everything is componentwise.›

lemma prod_ub_iff: "A <| b ⟷ fst ` A <| fst b ∧ snd ` A <| snd b"
  by (auto simp: is_ub_def below_prod_def)

instance prod :: (bounded_complete, bounded_complete) bounded_complete
proof
  fix A :: "('a × 'b) set" and b assume "A <| b"
  then have "fst ` A <<| lub (fst ` A)" "snd ` A <<| lub (snd ` A)"
    by (auto simp: prod_ub_iff intro: ex_bound_lub)
  then have "A <<| (lub (fst ` A), lub (snd ` A))"
    by (auto simp: is_lub_def prod_ub_iff below_prod_def)
  then show "∃a. A <<| a" ..
qed

lemma prod_joinable_iff: "x ⇑ y ⟷ fst x ⇑ fst y ∧ snd x ⇑ snd y"
  unfolding joinable_def below_prod_def by (metis fst_conv snd_conv)

context
  fixes x y :: "'a::bounded_complete × 'b::bounded_complete"
begin

lemma prod_meet: "x ⊓ y = (fst x ⊓ fst y, snd x ⊓ snd y)"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  show "x ⊓ y ⊑ (fst x ⊓ fst y, snd x ⊓ snd y)"
    using meet_below1[of x y] meet_below2[of x y] by (simp add: below_prod_def meet_greatest)
  show "(fst x ⊓ fst y, snd x ⊓ snd y) ⊑ x ⊓ y"
    by (rule meet_greatest) (simp_all add: below_prod_def meet_below1 meet_below2)
qed

lemma prod_join: "x ⇑ y ⟹ x ⊔ y = (fst x ⊔ fst y, snd x ⊔ snd y)"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  assume xy: "x ⇑ y"
  then have c: "fst x ⇑ fst y" "snd x ⇑ snd y" by (simp_all add: prod_joinable_iff)
  show "x ⊔ y ⊑ (fst x ⊔ fst y, snd x ⊔ snd y)"
    by (rule join_belowI) (simp_all add: below_prod_def joinableD[OF c(1)] joinableD[OF c(2)])
  show "(fst x ⊔ fst y, snd x ⊔ snd y) ⊑ x ⊔ y"
    using joinableD[OF xy] by (simp add: below_prod_def join_belowI)
qed

end

subsection ‹Smash products›

text ‹Componentwise, through @{thm [source] below_sprod}; the only care needed is that the pair
  of component lubs does not collapse, which holds as soon as one element is nonbottom.›

instance sprod :: (bounded_complete, bounded_complete) bounded_complete
proof
  fix A :: "('a ⊗ 'b) set" and b assume ne: "A ≠ {}" and ub: "A <| b"
  show "∃a. A <<| a"
  proof (cases "A = {⊥}")
    case True then show ?thesis by (auto intro: is_lubI is_ubI)
  next
    case False
    with ne obtain x0 where x0: "x0 ∈ A" "x0 ≠ ⊥" by blast
    have "(λx. sfst⋅x) ` A <| sfst⋅b" "(λx. ssnd⋅x) ` A <| ssnd⋅b"
      using ub by (auto intro!: is_ubI monofun_cfun_arg dest: is_ubD)
    then obtain L1 L2 where L1: "(λx. sfst⋅x) ` A <<| L1" and L2: "(λx. ssnd⋅x) ` A <<| L2"
      by (blast dest: ex_bound_ex_lub)
    have le: "sfst⋅x ⊑ L1" "ssnd⋅x ⊑ L2" if "x ∈ A" for x
      using that is_lubD1[OF L1] is_lubD1[OF L2] by (auto dest: is_ubD)
    have nb: "L1 ≠ ⊥" "L2 ≠ ⊥"
      using le[OF x0(1)] x0(2) by (auto dest: bottomI)
    have "A <<| (:L1, L2:)"
    proof (rule is_lubI)
      show "A <| (:L1, L2:)"
        using le nb by (auto intro!: is_ubI simp: below_sprod)
    next
      fix u assume u: "A <| u"
      have "L1 ⊑ sfst⋅u" "L2 ⊑ ssnd⋅u"
        using u by (auto intro!: is_lubD2[OF L1] is_lubD2[OF L2] is_ubI monofun_cfun_arg
          dest: is_ubD)
      then show "(:L1, L2:) ⊑ u" using nb by (simp add: below_sprod)
    qed
    then show ?thesis ..
  qed
qed

lemma sfst_spair_below: "sfst⋅(:x, y:) ⊑ x" and ssnd_spair_below: "ssnd⋅(:x, y:) ⊑ y"
  by (cases "y = ⊥"; simp) (cases "x = ⊥"; simp)

context
  fixes x x' :: "'a::bounded_complete" and y y' :: "'b::bounded_complete"
begin

text ‹Meets are componentwise without side conditions: a collapsing component makes the whole
  pair ‹⊥›, by strictness of @{const spair}.›

lemma spair_meet: "(:x, y:) ⊓ (:x', y':) = (:x ⊓ x', y ⊓ y':)"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  let ?m = "(:x, y:) ⊓ (:x', y':)"
  have "sfst⋅?m ⊑ x ⊓ x'" "ssnd⋅?m ⊑ y ⊓ y'"
    by (intro meet_greatest below_trans[OF monofun_cfun_arg[OF meet_below1] sfst_spair_below]
        below_trans[OF monofun_cfun_arg[OF meet_below2] sfst_spair_below]
        below_trans[OF monofun_cfun_arg[OF meet_below1] ssnd_spair_below]
        below_trans[OF monofun_cfun_arg[OF meet_below2] ssnd_spair_below])+
  then have "(:sfst⋅?m, ssnd⋅?m:) ⊑ (:x ⊓ x', y ⊓ y':)" by (intro monofun_cfun) simp_all
  then show "?m ⊑ (:x ⊓ x', y ⊓ y':)" by (simp only: spair_sfst_ssnd)
  show "(:x ⊓ x', y ⊓ y':) ⊑ ?m"
    by (intro meet_greatest monofun_cfun monofun_cfun_arg meet_below1 meet_below2)
qed

context
  assumes nb: "x ≠ ⊥" "y ≠ ⊥" "x' ≠ ⊥" "y' ≠ ⊥"
begin

lemma spair_joinable_iff: "(:x, y:) ⇑ (:x', y':) ⟷ x ⇑ x' ∧ y ⇑ y'"
proof
  assume "(:x, y:) ⇑ (:x', y':)"
  then obtain u where "(:x, y:) ⊑ u" "(:x', y':) ⊑ u" unfolding joinable_def by blast
  then show "x ⇑ x' ∧ y ⇑ y'" using nb by (auto simp: below_sprod intro: joinableI)
next
  assume "x ⇑ x' ∧ y ⇑ y'"
  then have "(:x, y:) ⊑ (:x ⊔ x', y ⊔ y':)" "(:x', y':) ⊑ (:x ⊔ x', y ⊔ y':)"
    by (auto intro!: monofun_cfun monofun_cfun_arg joinableD)
  then show "(:x, y:) ⇑ (:x', y':)" by (rule joinableI)
qed

lemma spair_join:
  assumes "x ⇑ x'" "y ⇑ y'" shows "(:x, y:) ⊔ (:x', y':) = (:x ⊔ x', y ⊔ y':)"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  have j: "(:x, y:) ⇑ (:x', y':)" using assms by (simp add: spair_joinable_iff)
  show "(:x, y:) ⊔ (:x', y':) ⊑ (:x ⊔ x', y ⊔ y':)"
    using assms by (intro join_belowI monofun_cfun monofun_cfun_arg joinableD)
  have "x ⊑ sfst⋅((:x, y:) ⊔ (:x', y':))" "x' ⊑ sfst⋅((:x, y:) ⊔ (:x', y':))"
    "y ⊑ ssnd⋅((:x, y:) ⊔ (:x', y':))" "y' ⊑ ssnd⋅((:x, y:) ⊔ (:x', y':))"
    using monofun_cfun_arg[OF joinableD(1)[OF j], of sfst] monofun_cfun_arg[OF joinableD(2)[OF j], of sfst]
      monofun_cfun_arg[OF joinableD(1)[OF j], of ssnd] monofun_cfun_arg[OF joinableD(2)[OF j], of ssnd]
    using nb by simp_all
  then have "(:x ⊔ x', y ⊔ y':) ⊑ (:sfst⋅((:x, y:) ⊔ (:x', y':)), ssnd⋅((:x, y:) ⊔ (:x', y':)):)"
    by (intro monofun_cfun monofun_cfun_arg join_belowI)
  then show "(:x ⊔ x', y ⊔ y':) ⊑ (:x, y:) ⊔ (:x', y':)" by (simp only: spair_sfst_ssnd)
qed

end

end

subclass (in flat) bounded_complete
proof
  fix A :: "'a set" and b :: 'a
  assume "A ≠ {}"
  assume "A <| b"
  then have "∀x ∈ A. x = ⊥ ∨ x = b" using is_ubD[THEN ax_flat] by blast
  with ‹A ≠ {}› consider "A = {b}" | "A = {⊥}" | "A = {⊥, b}"
    by fast
  then show "∃z. A <<| z"
    by (cases) (auto intro: is_lubI is_ubI dest: is_ubD)
qed


instantiation "fun" :: (type, bounded_complete) bounded_complete
begin

lemma fun_ub_iff: "A <| b ⟷ (∀p. (λf. f p) ` A <| b p)"
  by (auto simp add: is_ub_def fun_below_iff)

lemma fun_lub_iff: "A <<| b ⟷ (∀p. (λf. f p) ` A <<| b p)"
(is "?f ⟷ (∀p. ?p p)")
proof
  show "(∀p. ?p p) ⟹ ?f"
    by (auto simp add: is_lub_def is_ub_def fun_ub_iff fun_below_iff)
  show "(∀p. ?p p)" if "?f"
  proof (intro strip is_lubI)
    from that have b_ub: "A <| b" by (rule is_lubD1)
    fix p
    show "(λf. f p) ` A <| b p" using b_ub fun_ub_iff by fast
    fix u
    assume "(λf. f p) ` A <| u"
    with b_ub have "A <| b(p := u)"
      unfolding fun_ub_iff by simp
    with that have "b ⊑ b(p := u)"
      by (rule is_lubD2)
    from fun_belowD[OF this, of p] show "b p ⊑ u" by simp
  qed
qed

lemma fun_bounded_complete:
  fixes A :: "('a ⇒ 'b) set"
    and b
  assumes "A <| b"
  shows "A <<| (λp. (⨆f ∈ A. f p))"
proof -
  from assms have "(λf. f p) ` A <| b p" for p
    by (simp add: fun_ub_iff)
  then have "(λf. f p) ` A <<| (⨆f ∈ A. f p)" for p
    by (rule ex_bound_lub)
  then show "A <<| (λp. (⨆f ∈ A. f p))"
    by (simp add: fun_lub_iff)
qed

instance proof qed (blast intro: fun_bounded_complete)

end

lemma fun_lub:
  fixes A :: "('a::type ⇒ 'b::bounded_complete) set"
    and b
  assumes "A <| b"
  shows "lub A = (λp. (⨆f ∈ A. f p))"
  using lub_eqI[OF fun_bounded_complete, OF assms] .

lemma fun_join:
  fixes f g :: "'a::type ⇒ 'b::bounded_complete"
  assumes "f ⇑ g"
  shows "f ⊔ g = (λx. f x ⊔ g x)"
proof -
  from assms obtain z where "{f, g} <| z"
    by (auto simp add: joinable_def is_ub_def)
  from fun_lub[OF this]
  show ?thesis unfolding join_def by simp
qed

lemma fun_meet:
  fixes f g :: "'a::type ⇒ 'b::bounded_complete"
  shows "f ⊓ g = (λx. f x ⊓ g x)"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  show "f ⊓ g ⊑ (λx. f x ⊓ g x)"
  proof (rule fun_belowI)
    fix x
    have "(f ⊓ g) x ⊑ f x" "(f ⊓ g) x ⊑ g x"
      by (auto intro: fun_belowD meet_below1 meet_below2)
    thus "(f ⊓ g) x ⊑ (λx. f x ⊓ g x) x" by (simp add: meet_greatest)
  qed
next
  show "(λx. f x ⊓ g x) ⊑ f ⊓ g"
    by (rule meet_greatest; rule fun_belowI) (simp_all add: meet_below1 meet_below2)
qed


instantiation cfun :: (cpo, bounded_complete) bounded_complete
begin

lemma cfun_ub_iff: "A <| b ⟷ (∀p. (λf. f⋅p) ` A <| b⋅p)"
  by (auto simp add: is_ub_def cfun_below_iff)

lemma cfun_lubI: "(⋀p. (λf. f⋅p) ` A <<| b⋅p) ⟹ (A <<| b)"
by (simp add: is_lub_def cfun_ub_iff cfun_below_iff)

context
  fixes  A :: "('a → 'b) set"
    and b
  assumes Ab: "A <| b"
begin

private lemma pointwise_lubs: "(λf. f⋅p) ` A <<| (⨆ f ∈ A. f⋅p)" for p
proof -
  from Ab have "(λf. f⋅p) ` A <| b⋅p" for p
    by (auto dest: is_ubD intro!: is_ubI monofun_cfun_fun)
  then show ?thesis
    by (rule ex_bound_lub)
qed

lemma cfun_bound_cont[simp]: "(Λ p. (⨆f ∈ A. f⋅p))⋅p = (⨆ f ∈ A. f⋅p)" for p
proof (rule beta_cfun, rule contI)
  fix Y :: "nat ⇒ 'a" assume "chain Y"
  then have "range (λi. ⨆f∈A. f⋅(Y i)) <<| (⨆f∈A. (⨆i. f⋅(Y i)))"
    by (auto intro: chain_lub_family_converse pointwise_lubs)
  then show "range (λi. ⨆f∈A. f⋅(Y i)) <<| (⨆f∈A. f⋅(⨆i. Y i))"
    by (simp add: ‹chain Y› contlub_cfun_arg)
qed

lemma cfun_bounded_complete: "A <<| (Λ p. (⨆f ∈ A. f⋅p))"
  using pointwise_lubs by (simp add: is_lub_def is_ub_def cfun_below_iff)
end

instance proof qed (blast intro: cfun_bounded_complete)

end

lemma cfun_lub:
  fixes A :: "('a::cpo → 'b::bounded_complete) set"
    and b
  assumes "A <| b"
  shows "(lub A)⋅p = (⨆f ∈ A. f⋅p)"
  using cfun_bounded_complete[OF assms, THEN lub_eqI]
  cfun_bound_cont[OF assms] by simp

lemma cfun_join:
  fixes f g :: "'a::cpo → 'b::bounded_complete"
  assumes "f ⇑ g"
  shows "(f ⊔ g)⋅p = f⋅p ⊔ g⋅p"
proof -
  from assms obtain z where "{f, g} <| z"
    by (auto simp add: joinable_def is_ub_def)
  from cfun_lub[OF this]
  show ?thesis unfolding join_def by simp
qed

instantiation sfun :: (pcpo, bounded_complete) bounded_complete
begin

context
  fixes A and b :: "'a →! 'b"
  assumes Ab: "A <| b"
begin

private lemma sfun_cfun_lub: "(λf. sfun_rep⋅f) ` A <<| (⨆f ∈ A. sfun_rep⋅f)"
proof -
  from Ab have "(λf. sfun_rep⋅f) ` A <| sfun_rep⋅b"
    by (auto dest: is_ubD intro!: is_ubI monofun_cfun_arg)
  then show ?thesis by (rule ex_bound_lub)
qed

lemma sfun_lub_strict: "strictify⋅(⨆f ∈ A. sfun_rep⋅f) = (⨆f ∈ A. sfun_rep⋅f)"
(is "strictify⋅?lub = ?lub")
proof (rule below_antisym)
  show "strictify⋅?lub ⊑ ?lub" by (rule cfun_belowI) (simp add: strictify_conv_if)
  show "?lub ⊑ strictify⋅?lub" using sfun_cfun_lub
    apply (rule is_lubD2, intro is_ubI cfun_belowI)
    by (auto simp add: strictify_conv_if
          intro!: sfun_cfun_lub[THEN is_lubD1, THEN is_ubD, THEN monofun_cfun_fun])
qed

lemma sfun_bounded_complete:
  "A <<| sfun_abs⋅(⨆f ∈ A. sfun_rep⋅f)" (is "?A <<| sfun_abs⋅?lub")
proof -
  from sfun_cfun_lub have "(λf. sfun_rep⋅f) ` A <<| sfun_rep⋅(sfun_abs⋅?lub)"
    by (simp add: sfun_lub_strict)
  then show ?thesis
    by (simp add: is_lub_def is_ub_def sfun_below_iff)
qed

end

instance proof qed (blast intro: sfun_bounded_complete)

end

default_sort bifinite

lemma (in bounded_complete) lattice:
  assumes "⋀a b. a ⇑ b"
  shows "class.lattice meet below below_strict join"
  by (intro class.lattice.intro semilattice_meet class.semilattice_sup.intro below_order)
    (unfold_locales, auto intro: joinableD[OF assms] join_belowI)

lemma (in bounded_complete) bdd_above_iff:
"preorder.bdd_above (⊑) A ⟷ (∃a. A <| a)"
  unfolding preorder.bdd_above_def[OF class.order.axioms(1)[OF below_order]] is_ub_def
  by fast

lemma (in bounded_complete) cclattice:
  assumes "⋀a b. a ⇑ b"
  shows "class.conditionally_complete_lattice glb lub meet below below_strict join"
  by (intro class.conditionally_complete_lattice.intro lattice[OF assms])
    (unfold_locales, auto intro: joinableD[OF assms] join_belowI glb_below glb_greatest
      lub_belowI[unfolded is_ub_def] below_lubI simp add: bdd_above_iff)

instantiation lower_pd :: (bifinite) bounded_complete
begin
instance proof (intro bounded_complete_finite_compact_joinI')
  fix a b c :: "'a lower_pd"
  show "a ⊑ a ∪♭ b" "b ⊑ a ∪♭ b" by (fact lower_plus_below1 lower_plus_below2)+
  assume "a ⊑ c" "b ⊑ c"
  then show "a ∪♭ b ⊑ c" unfolding lower_plus_below_iff by presburger
qed

lemma joinable[simp]: "(a :: 'a lower_pd) ⇑ b" using lower_plus_below1 lower_plus_below2
  by (rule joinableI)

lemma lower_join_eq: "(a :: 'a lower_pd) ⊔ b = a ∪♭ b"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  from lower_plus_below1 lower_plus_below2 show "a ⊔ b ⊑ a ∪♭ b" by (rule join_belowI)
  from joinableD[OF joinable] show "a ∪♭ b ⊑ a ⊔ b"
    by (rule lower_plus_least)
qed


global_interpretation lower_pd_lattice: conditionally_complete_lattice "glb :: ('a lower_pd) set ⇒ ('a lower_pd)" lub meet below below_strict join
  using cclattice[OF joinable] .

end

definition min_ub :: "'a::po ⇒ 'a ⇒ 'a ⇒ bool"
  where "min_ub a b z ≡ a ⊑ z ∧ b ⊑ z ∧ (∀w. a ⊑ w ⟶ b ⊑ w ⟶ w ⊑ z ⟶ w = z)"

lemma min_ubI[intro]:
  assumes "a ⊑ z" "b ⊑ z" "⋀w. a ⊑ w ⟹ b ⊑ w ⟹ w ⊑ z ⟹ w = z"
  shows "min_ub a b z"
  unfolding min_ub_def using assms by blast

lemma min_ub_of_compact: fixes a b :: "'a::bifinite" assumes "compact a" "compact b"
  shows min_ub_below: "a ⊑ z ⟹ b ⊑ z ⟹ ∃w. min_ub a b w ∧ w ⊑ z"
    and min_ub_compact: "⋀w. min_ub a b w ⟹ compact w"
    and min_ub_finite: "finite {w. min_ub a b w}"
proof -
  from bifinite obtain approx :: "nat ⇒ 'a → 'a" where "approx_chain approx" ..
  then interpret approx_chain approx .
  have idem_mono: "i ≤ j ⟹ approx i⋅x = x ⟹ approx j⋅x = x" for i j x
  proof -
    assume "i ≤ j" then have "approx i⋅x ⊑ approx j⋅x"
      by (rule chain_approx[THEN chain_mono, THEN monofun_cfun_fun])
    also assume "approx i⋅x = x"
    also have "approx j⋅x ⊑ x" by (rule approx_below)
    finally show ?thesis ..
  qed

  from compact_eq_approx assms(1,2) obtain i j where f: "approx i⋅a = a" "approx j⋅b = b"
    by blast
  define k where "k = max i j"
  with f have idem: "approx k⋅a = a" "approx k⋅b = b"
    by (auto intro: idem_mono max.cobounded1 max.cobounded2)
  define D where "D ≡ range (λx. approx k⋅x)"  
  have "finite D" unfolding D_def by (rule finite_range_approx)

  {
    fix z :: 'a
    define z' where "z' = approx k⋅z"
    assume "a ⊑ z" "b ⊑ z"
    with idem have deflated: "a ⊑ z'" "b ⊑ z'"
    unfolding z'_def
    by (metis monofun_cfun_arg)+
    define B where "B = {x ∈ D. a ⊑ x ∧ b ⊑ x ∧ x ⊑ z'}"
    from ‹finite D› have fin: "finite B" unfolding B_def by force
    have "z' ∈ D" unfolding z'_def D_def by simp
    then have "z' ∈ B" unfolding B_def using deflated by force
    then have ne: "B ≠ {}" by blast
    from fin ne have "∃mu ∈ B. (∀x ∈ B. x ⊑ mu ⟶ x = mu)"
    proof (induction B rule: finite_ne_induct)
      case (singleton x)
      then show ?case by simp
    next
      case (insert nu F)
      show ?case
        by (metis insert.IH below_trans insert_iff po_eq_conv)
    qed
    then obtain mu where "mu ∈ B" and muR: "⋀x. x ∈ B ⟹ x ⊑ mu ⟹ x = mu"
      by blast
    have mu_idem: "approx k⋅mu = mu"
      using ‹mu ∈ B›[unfolded B_def D_def]
      approx_idem by blast
    have mu_lower: "mu ⊑ z'" using ‹mu ∈ B›[unfolded B_def] by blast
    have "min_ub a b mu"
    proof
      from ‹mu ∈ B›[unfolded B_def] show "a ⊑ mu" "b ⊑ mu" by simp_all
      fix w assume "a ⊑ w" "b ⊑ w" "w ⊑ mu"
      with idem mu_idem have "a ⊑ approx k⋅w ∧ b ⊑ approx k⋅w"
        and under: "approx k⋅w ⊑ mu"
        by (metis monofun_cfun_arg)+
      with mu_lower have "approx k⋅w ∈ B" unfolding B_def D_def
        using below_trans by blast
      from this under have "approx k⋅w = mu" by (rule muR)
      then have "mu ⊑ w" using approx_below by blast
      with ‹w ⊑ mu› show "w = mu" by (rule below_antisym)
    qed
    moreover from mu_lower[unfolded z'_def] approx_below have "mu ⊑ z"
      by (rule below_trans)
    ultimately show "∃w. min_ub a b w ∧ w ⊑ z" by blast
  }
  {
    have w_idem: "approx k⋅w = w" if "min_ub a b w" for w
    proof -
      from that have "a ⊑ w ∧ b ⊑ w" by (simp add: min_ub_def)
      with idem have "a ⊑ approx k⋅w ∧ b ⊑ approx k⋅w"
        by (metis monofun_cfun_arg)
      with that approx_below show ?thesis by (simp add: min_ub_def)
    qed
    then have "{w. min_ub a b w} ⊆ D" unfolding D_def 
      by (simp add: Collect_mono_iff deflation.range_eq_fixes
          deflation_approx)
    from this ‹finite D› show "finite {w. min_ub a b w}" by (rule finite_subset)
    from w_idem show "min_ub a b w ⟹ compact w" for w by (metis compact_approx)
  }
qed



context begin
private alias Cb = Rep_compact_basis
definition pd_sup_set :: "'a pd_basis ⇒ 'a pd_basis ⇒ 'a compact_basis set"
  where "pd_sup_set A B ≡
⋃a ∈ Rep_pd_basis A. ⋃b ∈ Rep_pd_basis B. {w. min_ub (Cb a) (Cb b) (Cb w)}"

lemma finite_pd_sup_set: "finite (pd_sup_set A B)"
proof -
  {
    fix a b :: "'a compact_basis"
    have c: "compact (Cb a)" "compact (Cb b)" by simp_all
    note min_ub_finite = min_ub_finite[OF c]
    note min_ub_compact = min_ub_compact[OF c]
    have "finite {w. min_ub (Cb a) (Cb b) w}"
      by (auto intro: min_ub_finite)
    moreover have "{w. min_ub (Cb a) (Cb b) (Cb w)} = Abs_compact_basis ` ..."
      using Abs_compact_basis_inverse'[OF min_ub_compact, symmetric]
      by (auto intro: Rep_compact_basis_inverse[symmetric])

    ultimately have "finite {w. min_ub (Rep_compact_basis a) (Rep_compact_basis b) (Rep_compact_basis w)}"
      using finite_imageI by simp
  }
  with finite_Rep_pd_basis
  show ?thesis unfolding pd_sup_set_def by blast
qed

definition "pd_sup A B ≡ Abs_pd_basis (pd_sup_set A B)"

lemma pd_sup_rep: "pd_sup_set A B ≠ {} ⟹ Rep_pd_basis (pd_sup A B) = pd_sup_set A B"
  unfolding pd_sup_def
  using finite_pd_sup_set
    Abs_pd_basis_inverse[unfolded pd_basis_def mem_Collect_eq]
  by blast

lemma min_ub_Cb_def:
  fixes a b z :: "'a::bifinite compact_basis"
  shows "min_ub (Cb a) (Cb b) (Cb z) ⟷ a ⊑ z ∧ b ⊑ z ∧ (∀w. a ⊑ w ⟶ b ⊑ w ⟶ w ⊑ z ⟶ w = z)"
proof -
  let ?noncompact = "∀w. Cb a ⊑ w ⟶ Cb b ⊑ w ⟶ w ⊑ Cb z ⟶ w = Cb z"
  let ?compact = "∀w. a ⊑ w ⟶ b ⊑ w ⟶ w ⊑ z ⟶ w = z"
  have "?noncompact ⟷ ?compact"
    term type_definition
  proof
    show "?noncompact ⟹ ?compact" unfolding compact_le_def
      using type_definition.Rep_inject[OF type_definition_compact_basis]
      by blast
    show "?noncompact" if "?compact"
    proof (intro allI)
      show "Cb a ⊑ w ⟶ Cb b ⊑ w ⟶ w ⊑ Cb z ⟶ w = Cb z" (is "?P w") for w
      proof (induction w rule: compact_basis.principal_induct)
        from Rep_compact_basis'[unfolded compact_def]
        show "adm ?P" by simp
        from that show "?P (Cb w)" for w by auto
      qed
    qed
  qed
  then show ?thesis unfolding min_ub_def by simp
qed

lemma min_ub_below':
  fixes a z :: "'a::bifinite compact_basis"
  shows "a ⊑ z ⟹ b ⊑ z ⟹ ∃w. min_ub (Cb a) (Cb b) (Cb w) ∧ w ⊑ z"
proof -
  assume "a ⊑ z" "b ⊑ z"
  from this[unfolded compact_le_def] obtain w where 1: "min_ub (Cb a) (Cb b) w" and 2: "w ⊑ Cb z"
    using min_ub_below Rep_compact_basis' by blast
  from 1 have "compact w" using Rep_compact_basis' min_ub_compact by blast
  then have "w = Cb (Abs_compact_basis w)" by simp
  with 1 2 compact_le_def show ?thesis by metis
qed

lemma pd_sup_ex: assumes "A ≤♯ Z" "B ≤♯ Z"
  shows pd_sup_ne: "pd_sup_set A B ≠ {}"
    and pd_sup_le: "pd_sup A B ≤♯ Z"
proof -
  {
    fix z assume  z: "z ∈ Rep_pd_basis Z"
    from z assms(1)[unfolded upper_le_def] obtain a where a: "a ∈ Rep_pd_basis A" "a ⊑ z"
      by blast
    from z assms(2)[unfolded upper_le_def] obtain b where b: "b ∈ Rep_pd_basis B" "b ⊑ z"
      by blast
    from a(2) b(2) obtain w where w: "min_ub (Cb a) (Cb b) (Cb w)" "w ⊑ z" using min_ub_below'
      by blast
    from a(1) b(1) w(1) have "w ∈ pd_sup_set A B" unfolding pd_sup_set_def by blast
    with w(2) have "∃w ∈ pd_sup_set A B. w ⊑ z" by blast
  }
  note sup_finder = this
  from Rep_pd_basis_nonempty obtain z where "z ∈ Rep_pd_basis Z" by blast
  from sup_finder[OF this] show "pd_sup_set A B ≠ {}" by blast
  then have "Rep_pd_basis (pd_sup A B) = pd_sup_set A B" by (rule pd_sup_rep)
  with sup_finder show "pd_sup A B ≤♯ Z" unfolding upper_le_def by blast
qed

lemma pd_sup_ge:
  assumes "pd_sup_set A B ≠ {}"
  shows "A ≤♯ pd_sup A B" "B ≤♯ pd_sup A B"
  unfolding upper_le_def pd_sup_rep[OF assms] 
    pd_sup_set_def min_ub_Cb_def
  by blast+

end


instantiation upper_pd :: (bifinite) bounded_complete
begin
(* It would be really convenient to have a top in upper PDs but alas *)
instance
proof (rule bounded_complete_finite_compact_joinI')
  fix x y z :: "'a upper_pd"
  assume z: "x ⊑ z" "y ⊑ z"
  define unp :: "'a upper_pd ⇒ 'a pd_basis"
    where "unp x = (SOME xb. x = upper_principal xb)" for x
  have unp_p: "compact x ⟹ x = upper_principal (unp x)" for x
    unfolding unp_def
    by (drule upper_pd.compact_imp_principal) (rule someI_ex)
  define xb where "xb = unp x"
  define yb where "yb = unp y"
  define zb where "zb = unp z"
  assume "compact x" "compact y" "compact z"
  with upper_pd.compact_imp_principal
  have princ: "x = upper_principal xb" "y = upper_principal yb"
    "z = upper_principal zb" unfolding xb_def yb_def zb_def by (fast intro: unp_p)+
  with z have "xb ≤♯ zb" "yb ≤♯ zb" by simp_all 
  from pd_sup_ex[OF this]
  have "xb ≤♯ pd_sup xb yb" "yb ≤♯ pd_sup xb yb" "pd_sup xb yb ≤♯ zb"
    by (auto intro: pd_sup_ge)
  with princ show 
    "x ⊑ upper_principal (pd_sup xb yb)"
    "y ⊑ upper_principal (pd_sup xb yb)"
    "upper_principal (pd_sup xb yb) ⊑ z" by simp_all
qed

lemma upper_meet_eq: "x ⊓ y = x ∪♯ y"
proof (rule below_antisym)
  show "x ∪♯ y ⊑ x ⊓ y" using meet_below_iff upper_plus_below1 upper_plus_below2
    by fast
  show "x ⊓ y ⊑ x ∪♯ y" using upper_below_plus_iff meet_below1 meet_below2 by fast
qed

end

theorem upper_pd_self_rep: "s = glb {{x}♯ | x. s ⊑ {x}♯}" sorry
*)

instantiation top :: (bounded_complete) bounded_complete
begin

lemma top_is_ub_transfer: "(λx. down⋅x) ` A <| down⋅w ⟷ A <| w"
  unfolding is_ub_def by simp

lemma top_is_lub_transfer: "A <<| w ⟹ (λx. down⋅x) ` A <<| down⋅w"
proof (rule is_lubI)
  show "A <<| w ⟹ (λx. down⋅x) ` A <| down⋅w" by (auto dest: is_lubD1 simp add: top_is_ub_transfer)
  show "A <<| w ⟹ (λx. down⋅x) ` A <| u ⟹ down⋅w ⊑ u" for u
    by (cases u) (auto dest: is_lubD2 simp add: top_is_ub_transfer)
qed

lemma is_ub_Top: "A <| Top"
  by (auto intro: is_ubI)

instance
proof
  fix A :: "'a top set" and b
  show "∃a. A <<| a"
  proof (cases "Top ∈ A")
    case True
    then have "A <<| Top" by (rule top_lub_Top)
    then show ?thesis ..
  next
    case False
    then have 1: "∀x ∈ A. ∃y. x = down⋅y" by (metis top_cases)
    define A' where "A' = {y. ∃x ∈ A. x = down⋅y}"
    with 1 have 2: "A = (λx. down⋅x) ` A'" by fast
    show ?thesis proof (cases "∃w. A' <<| w")
      case True
      then show ?thesis unfolding 2 by (fast intro: top_is_lub_transfer)
    next
      case False
      with ex_bound_ex_lub have 3: "∄w. A' <| w" by auto
      then have 4: "A <| w ⟹ w = Top" for w
        unfolding 2 using top_is_ub_transfer by (cases w) auto
      then have "A <<| Top" by (auto intro: is_lubI simp add: is_ub_Top)
      then show ?thesis ..
    qed
  qed
qed

lemmas top_is_lub = ex_bound_ex_lub[OF is_ub_Top]
lemmas top_lub = ex_bound_lub[OF is_ub_Top]

lemmas top_join_is_lub = join_is_lub[OF below_Top below_Top]

lemma [simp]: "(a :: 'a top) ⇑ b" by (auto intro: joinableI below_Top)

end

subsection ‹Joins: auxiliary lemmas›

lemma bottom_joinable: "⊥ ⇑ (y::'a::bounded_complete)"
  by (auto simp add: joinable_def)

lemma cfun_arg_joinable:
  fixes a b :: "'a::bounded_complete" and f :: "'a → 'b::bounded_complete"
  assumes "a ⇑ b" shows "f⋅a ⇑ f⋅b"
  using assms unfolding joinable_def by (blast intro: monofun_cfun_arg)

text ‹Deflations lie below @{term ID}, so any two are joinable.›

lemma deflation_joinable:
  assumes "deflation p" and "deflation q" shows "p ⇑ q"
  by (rule joinableI[OF deflation.below_ID[OF assms(1)] deflation.below_ID[OF assms(2)]])

lemma compact_join:
  fixes x y :: "'a::bounded_complete"
  assumes x: "compact x" and y: "compact y" and xy: "x ⇑ y"
  shows "compact (x ⊔ y)"
proof (rule compactI2)
  fix Y :: "nat ⇒ 'a" assume Y: "chain Y" and le: "x ⊔ y ⊑ (⨆i. Y i)"
  from le joinableD[OF xy] have "x ⊑ (⨆i. Y i)" "y ⊑ (⨆i. Y i)"
    by (blast intro: below_trans)+
  then obtain i j where "x ⊑ Y i" "y ⊑ Y j"
    using compactD2[OF x Y] compactD2[OF y Y] by blast
  then have "x ⊑ Y (max i j)" "y ⊑ Y (max i j)"
    using chain_mono[OF Y] by (blast intro: below_trans max.cobounded1 max.cobounded2)+
  then show "∃i. x ⊔ y ⊑ Y i" by (blast intro: join_belowI)
qed

lemma insert_join_is_lub:
  fixes S :: "'a::bounded_complete set"
  assumes Sl: "S <<| l" and j: "z ⇑ l"
  shows "insert z S <<| z ⊔ l"
proof (rule is_lubI)
  show "insert z S <| z ⊔ l"
  proof (rule is_ubI)
    fix w assume w: "w ∈ insert z S"
    show "w ⊑ z ⊔ l"
    proof (cases "w = z")
      case True then show ?thesis by (simp add: joinableD(1)[OF j])
    next
      case False with w have "w ∈ S" by simp
      with is_lubD1[OF Sl] have "w ⊑ l" by (rule is_ubD)
      also have "l ⊑ z ⊔ l" by (rule joinableD(2)[OF j])
      finally show ?thesis .
    qed
  qed
next
  fix u assume "insert z S <| u"
  then have zu: "z ⊑ u" and Su: "S <| u" by (auto simp: is_ub_insert)
  from Sl Su have "l ⊑ u" by (rule is_lubD2)
  with zu show "z ⊔ l ⊑ u" by (rule join_belowI)
qed

end
